dogecoin.text: @DaveMichels @cwalker123 @EvanKirstel @JohnSaw @TMobile Ask about their #dogecoin strategy and if they have some on their balance sheet
@BENBALLER All the youngsters who were 10yo when #bitcoin was this cheap see this as their shot at riches. #Dogecoin will be $5 by end of summer

@ShaanVP Elon backed himself into a corner, the more he pumps #dogecoin, the more he becomes the face of it and knows he can single handedly bankrupt many thousands of people who went all in or heavy into #dogecoin. He has to keep the party going at this point.

@Jason People new to crypto know that their shot at riches with #bitcoin is likely long gone, yes it may double or triple from here in the near term (hope so!) - but with a smallish portfolio (say <$50K) might as well yolo on #dogecoin and others for  chance to 20x and move to bitcoin

@Jason #dogecoin total "market cap" is near 10% of #bitcoin. Scarcity in crypto is an illusion. Sure, there can only ever be 21M bitcoins. But does it matter? #ETH is up, #litecoin is up, #dogecoin mooning. Each alt coin success diminishes the promise of #bitcoin.

@BarrySilbert It's funny to see how #bitcoin maximalists fear the nonsensical rise of #dogecoin - perhaps afraid the whole house of cards will come down. Harder to sell the scarcity of 21M bitcoins when crypto itself is no longer scarce as a whole
@danielsinger The people moving are bringing with them their #dogecoin, no need for a job, pretty solid UBI
